definitions.explanation: The second-highest administrative position at a school, directly below the principal. Responsible for assisting the principal with school management and often handling day-to-day operations.

examples.japanese: {教頭|きょうとう}⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれた→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: I was called by the vice-principal.

examples.japanese: {教頭|きょうとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代|か}わり→代わり：01296_kawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The vice-principal gave a greeting in place of the principal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{教頭|きょうとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: It's been decided that I'll be promoted to vice-principal starting next year.

notes:
USAGE:
{教頭|きょうとう} is addressed as {教頭|きょうとう}⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧ by students and staff. The role involves managing school schedules, supervising teachers, and handling administrative tasks that the ⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧ (principal) delegates.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教頭|きょうとう}⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧ (vice-principal — polite address)
- {教頭|きょうとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be promoted to vice-principal)
- ⟦{副|ふく}{校長|こうちょう}→副校長：23995_fukukouchou⟧ (vice-principal — alternative title used in some schools)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{副|ふく}{校長|こうちょう}→副校長：23995_fukukouchou⟧ is an alternative title for the same position, used in some school systems. In schools that have both, ⟦{副|ふく}{校長|こうちょう}→副校長：23995_fukukouchou⟧ may outrank {教頭|きょうとう}.
